messages:
Sara: Heads up — want to schedule a 45m inference metrics roundtable to go over latency/cost readouts, quant tests, and rollout risks. Proposed slots: Tue 10–11am PT, Wed 3–3:45pm PT, Thu 9–9:45am PT. Who can make any? Also propose agenda: 1) latency dashboards + spike anomalies, 2) cost per-token trends + quant impacts, 3) benchmark readout (summary), 4) rollout decision. Need final slot by EOD today.

Ben: Prefer Tue 10. Can we add a quick comparison against the last stable release (v1.8.2)? I can present Q8 vs Q4 numbers in 8m.

Leo: Wed 3pm works better for me. If we keep 45m, maybe drop the deep quant deep-dive and schedule a follow-up dedicated to quantization.

Maria: I can present the latency dashboard. @Sara can you paste links to dashboards + latest benchmark run IDs? I'll prep a 5–7 slide pre-read.

Sara: Links below. Latest run: run-20260310-02. Adding dedicated vs hosted breakdown. Agenda adjusted to keep quant as a summary only. I'll send calendar invite once slot decided.

Nate: If Tue 10 gets most +1s, I'm in. One request: include Dedicated tail-latency percentiles (p95/p99) for GPU pooling tests. cc: @Ben

Ben: :thumbsup: will include p95/p99. Quick query I'll use for p99 (Prometheus):
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))
```

deploy-bot: Calendar provisional created: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/abc123 — awaiting final ack.

Maria: SGTM Tue 10. Pre-read link: https://internal.redwood.ai/notebooks/inference-readout-20260310 — I'll drop slides & brief notes there.

Leo: If Tue wins, can we add 10 min at the end for a rollout freeze decision? That avoids follow-ups.

Sara: Yep added a 10m decision slot at the end. Finalizing invite if Tue 10 gets 4+.

Nate: I can make Tue. +1 for freeze decision.

Ben: Tue 10 works for me. Will upload benchmark CSVs and diff tables to the pre-read folder.

Maria: Thanks all — I'll upload slides by 4pm today.

ci-bot: Benchmark artifacts archived: s3://redwood-inference/runs/run-20260310-02/ (CSV, traces, perf.json)

Sara: :thumbsup: locking Tue 10am PT. Invite + materials sent. See you there.
